scale.lexicalLoad: 0 supported/familiar; 1 modest supported extra vocabulary; 2 concentrated or unsupported load
scale.decisionLoad: 0 supplied form/unit; 1 one meaningful choice; 2 interacting distinctions
scale.calculation: 0 no arithmetic, including supplied quantities, notation and direct cardinality; 1 one actual arithmetic step; 2 multiple steps

rubric.assignment: All vectors are independently assigned here, not copied from an author. They summarize the record's applicable task demands, with mode differences recorded separately. Feedback runs in the opposite evaluative direction from load; these vectors must not be summed into a difficulty score.
rubric.modeRule: Read exposes the canonical phrase; it is not independent counter selection. Write cues usually supply the counter. Small enumerations such as three named flavors/room identifiers are not claimed as arithmetic training.

runtimeAudit.sourceWideLabels: Every one of the 16 file counter/base-reading pairs agrees with counter-labels.json, including shared 人前, 点, 房, 切れ, 丁 and the existing 個 label. Base readings are not falsely substituted for compound readings.
runtimeAudit.v1: Choose/Type were assessed from Japanese and inline glosses alone. English and notes were treated as answer-side. Bare-unit and full-count members were checked as alternative whole counting phrases, not by incorrectly concatenating a full answer after the existing numeral. Good precedes kana/Hard; kana folding is respected.
runtimeAudit.v2: All 24 cues confine the requested written unit, preserve the quantity and give the kanji-or-Arabic instruction expressly for writing. All 48 written members are the correct kanji/Arabic pair. This is not an instruction to enter numerals in Read.
runtimeAudit.normalization: Applied the contract's NFKC/whitespace rules and reading-only katakana folding for v2; no numeral arithmetic or unlisted spelling conversion was assumed. For example, ３ 人前 normalizes to 3人前, not 三人前; both happen to be authored separately where needed. さんべや and さんへや remain distinct. V1 alternate-counter kana is not imported into canonical Read.
runtimeAudit.staticChecks: Every canonical reading is in its readingAnswers, every v2 written model is in writtenAnswers, no normalized duplicates in those two fields, and every v1 phrase occurs in the canonical completed sentence. These are content-only checks, not product tests.
runtimeAudit.exhaustivenessLimit: The enumerated authored members were all assessed. This does not claim discovery of every dialectal, historical, industry or conceivable colloquial alternative.

records.answersEvidence: Each written member preserves three. 人分 describes an intended amount; つ is generic ordering; 食 counts meals/servings; 杯 and 皿 require their compatible serving styles, which the prompt leaves open. さんばい has the expected voicing; さんさら/みさら are documented in S9. The same openness also admits missing 枚 and restaurant-order 丁: F1. Read correctly uses only 三人前/さんにんまえ, not alternate-unit kana.
